CallNotes
arr.sort()
  • sorts in place
  • returns the array

Code

function insertionSort(a) {
  for (let i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
    let j = i;
    while (j > 0 && a[j - 1] > a[j]) { [a[j - 1], a[j]] = [a[j], a[j - 1]]; j--; }
  }
  return a;
}
def heap_sort(a):
    heapq.heapify(a)
    return [heapq.heappop(a) for _ in range(len(a))]
